memory.content: Prefer calculating influencer Reel CPMs from the median views of their most recent 3 brand collab posts (paidPartnership/#ad/clear brand CTA) rather than organic Reels, then apply $5–$25 CPM.

Typical influencer pilots are ~90 days with Meta Partnership Ads / whitelisting; deliverables usually one Reel total or one Reel per month (often with Stories), sometimes with optional organic view bonuses.

When a creator's brand-collab Reels far outperform their organic Reels (e.g. 15×+), the collabs were likely boosted as ads; price off organic reach plus a small premium instead of paying CPM on ad-bought views.
When pure CPM gives a tiny fee for a nano creator (median under ~10k plays), apply a practical flat floor instead of quoting literal CPM fees.

View data comes from the Apify connector (apify/instagram-reel-scraper actor, videoPlayCount). On first use, ask the new owner which brand they price for, their usual deal shape, CPM range, and whether Apify is connected.

# Influencer Reel CPM + deal draft

User pastes a creator profile URL or handle. Return collab-based CPM math, pay options for common deal shapes, and a paste-ready partnership agreement draft. Drafts only: never negotiate, DM, book, or spend.

## 1. Scrape
Apify `apify/instagram-reel-scraper` (username, resultsLimit >= 25). Use videoPlayCount (fallback videoViewCount). Note paidPartnership, caption, owner, date.

## 2. View basis
Walk newest to older. Take the most recent 3 brand collab Reels owned by the creator (paidPartnership, #ad, #sponsored, #gifted, discount code, named-brand hard sell). Exclude other accounts' posts and soft affiliate alone. List date, brand, caption, plays; use the median. Fallback with zero collabs: last ~10 organic median. Compare to organic median: if collabs are far higher, they were likely boosted, so price closer to organic with a small premium.

## 3. Fee table
Fee = (median_views / 1000) x CPM. Ladder $5/$10/$15/$20/$25; recommend $10-$20. For nano creators apply a flat floor. If they quote a fee, Implied CPM = Fee / (views/1000).

## 4. Deal menu (90-day term + Partnership Ads/whitelisting)
- A: 1 Reel + 90-day whitelist. Base about $15 CPM.
- B (default ambassador): 1 Reel/month x 3 + 2 Story sequences/month + whitelist. About 3 x A with 5-10% package discount.
- B+: B plus category exclusivity (+15-25%).
- C: custom line items.
Optional organic view bonus (threshold ~3-4x their median). Counter floor ~70-75% of first ask.

## 5. Output
Handle, collabs used, median, band; fee table; A/B/B+ with first-ask $; a short paste-ready agreement for the default option.

## 6. Agreement outline
Title BRAND x CREATOR 90-day pilot; prepared for/by/date/term; the partnership; why it fits; 90-day plan; deliverables; what the brand provides (product, code, brief, feedback, paid setup); rights (90-day Partnership Ads from first launch, organic repost 12 months, no synthetic face/voice, FTC disclosure); exclusivity; investment table; how we measure, next steps, signatures. Label: Draft only, not a signed contract; have counsel review.

## Creator-side rate card (when pricing for a creator selling to brands)
Price the Reel off the higher of CPM on organic median or a follower norm (~$100 per 10k followers, more for high-value niches). Then Story sequence, Reel+Story bundle, carousel, UGC-only video, 3-month ambassador. Add-ons priced separately, never folded into the base: Partnership Ads +25% (30d) / +50% (90d), paid usage +40%, exclusivity per month, rush +25%, raw footage, TikTok repost. Give walk-away minimums at ~70-75%. Provide a reply email to an inbound offer and a general rate-card pitch email.
